_readme: Keys whose value is ALLOWED to stay byte-identical to English, per locale.
scripts/check-i18n.mjs fails on any OTHER key copied from en.json, because a key
that merely EXISTS is not a key that is translated. The old parity check passed
for months while /debts rendered half in English for anyone reading Malayalam.
"locales": ["*"] means every language; a list means only those. A word that is
a loanword in German but not in Tamil belongs on the German list alone.
Add an entry only when the English really IS the right string there: a brand, an
international standard (IBAN, PDF), sample data, a string with no words in it, or
a genuine loanword. "I could not think of a translation" is not a reason — ask a
speaker, or keep the key out of the release.
"why" is read by humans in review. Keep it short and true.
